items.title: Make waiver rows visible to the evidence-freshness report
items.context: packages/main/src/handlers/evidence-refresh.ts filters waivers in refreshOnlyDrift()/isWaiver() before checkEvidenceFreshnessForGit runs, so verification_evidence_refresh_stale --dryRun reports "No stale verification evidence" for a story whose waiver bindings are far out of date. Whatever the correction policy ends up being, the report must stop being silent.
items.userSees: verification_evidence_refresh_stale --dryRun on a story with an out-of-date waiver lists that waiver instead of reporting no stale evidence.

items.title: Decide and implement the waiver rebinding policy, automatic or operator-driven
items.context: Rebinding a waiver requires no command execution, so an automatic restamp is cheap; but a waiver that silently follows the tree could hide a case where its justification stopped being true. Pick one policy, implement it, and state the reasoning in code rather than in a comment. On B-7dff both waivers were rebound by hand with their text unchanged, which is the behaviour to either automate or deliberately keep manual.
items.userSees: A stale waiver either is rebound by the documented automatic path, or the tool prints the exact command the operator must run and why the step is not automatic.

items.title: Fail earlier than the DONE gate when a consuming gate would reject a stale waiver
items.context: On B-7dff the staleness surfaced only at story_advance DONE, after reviewer receipts and quorum had been minted, and fixing it invalidated all of them. milestone_status showed the problem but disclaims being a gate, which led two reviewers to call it benign. Surface it where it can still be fixed cheaply, for example in done_prepare or lifecycle_check --target=DONE.
items.userSees: done_prepare or lifecycle_check reports a stale waiver binding as a blocker before reviewer receipts are minted, rather than the DONE advance failing on stale_milestone_evidence afterwards.
